title: Voice synth tuning — push CV-babble from 'chirps' toward 'speech' via vowel/consonant length + formant glide + softer pitch contours
intent: User playtest 2026-05-28: 'мы же хотели синтез речи сделать для ботов, что-то пока не похоже на речь если работает, проверь'. The S110 CV-babble synth (FEAT-PROCEDURAL-CV-BABBLE-VOC-001) ships the right design shape — 10 voice knobs, 5 multi-syllable phrase patches, source-filter formant per vowel. But the SHIPPED NUMBERS produce 'chirps + bleeps' for listeners, not 'speech'. Diagnosis: vowel pulses are 60ms (too short — natural speech vowels are 80-200ms, listeners parse <70ms as percussion); pitch contours swing 1.0..1.5 (50% — too musical, real speech intonation is <15% per syllable); formants are static within each vowel (real speech vowels GLIDE between F1/F2 targets); consonant transients are 12-15ms (too brief for clear articulation). This story is the tuning pass + one small implementation extension (formant glide). The QA bar from voice-synth-design.md §8 stays unchanged: 'they're talking', not 'they're beeping'.
rationale: Source: user playtest feedback 2026-05-28 + audit of `examples/kaboom-crew/src/voice-synth.ts` against `docs/game-design/voice-synth-design.md §8` listener test. Spec correctly captured intent but the specific numeric ranges (vowel 60ms, consonant 12-15ms, pitch swing 50%) were design-intent guesses — never playtested. Tuning pass closes the gap between intent and percep. Marked `should` because the feature already SHIPS and works mechanically — this is presentation polish on top of shipped code, not a re-design.
acceptanceHints: AUDIT TARGET: `examples/kaboom-crew/src/voice-synth.ts` — PHRASE_PATCHES + planUtterance + emitUtterance. Tests in `examples/kaboom-crew/tests/unit/voice-synth.test.ts` will need updates for the new tuning values + the new formant-glide field.
TUNING CHANGE 1 — vowel duration (highest impact):
Each PHRASE_PATCHES entry's vowelDurationS: 0.060 → 0.110 (~doubled). 110ms is the lower bound of natural speech vowel length.
Death slot: 0.080 → 0.140 (longest — death is the most extended).
Total utterance lengths recalculate accordingly — place-bomb 3-syl becomes ~390ms (was 270ms); victory 5-syl becomes ~670ms (was 460ms). Still under the 1s gameplay-event budget.
TUNING CHANGE 2 — consonant duration:
consonantDurationS: 0.015 → 0.030 (doubled). 30ms is mid-range for articulated consonants. Sharper attack, clearer 'b/d/g/p/t/k' distinction.
TUNING CHANGE 3 — pitch contour swing (soften):

Current contours: place-bomb [1.0,1.0,1.0] (already flat ✓), hit [1.0,0.7] (30% drop), pickup [1.0,1.15,1.3] (30% rise), death [1.0,0.85,0.7,0.55] (45% drop), victory [1.0,1.15,1.3,1.45,1.5] (50% rise).

Revised: pickup [1.0,1.08,1.18] (max 18% rise, more conversational), victory [1.0,1.08,1.18,1.28,1.32] (max 32% rise — still flourishing but less melodic), death [1.0,0.92,0.82,0.72] (28% drop, deflating not melodic).
hit STAYS at 0.7 (sharp drops are speech-natural for exclamations).
place-bomb STAYS flat (neutral mutter).
Goal: peaks/troughs feel like intonation, not melody intervals.
TUNING CHANGE 4 — vowel drift amount:

VOICE_RANGES.vowelDriftAmount: [0, 0.3] → [0.2, 0.6]. Forces a MINIMUM drift of 20% (no 0-drift 'monotone' bombers); ceiling at 60% allows much more vowel variation. Different syllables sound more like 'i/a/u/o' instead of all sounding the same.
TUNING CHANGE 5 — formant glide within vowel (impl extension, ~30 LOC):
Each vowel pulse currently sets static F1/F2 + envelope. Real speech vowels GLIDE between targets. Add a 'formantGlideAmount' field to VoiceColour: range 0..0.4 (default seed-derived).

Implementation: in emitUtterance vowel scheduling, schedule the bandpass filter's frequency.linearRampToValueAtTime from (F1, F2) at vowel start to (F1 × (1 + glide × cosToNextSyllable), F2 × (1 + glide × sinToNextSyllable)) at vowel midpoint, then back. Mild micro-formant motion.
Without this change: vowels stay 'beep'-shaped (static spectrum) even if length is doubled.
With this change: vowels read as 'voiced speech' (moving spectrum).
TUNING CHANGE 6 — pitch jitter (cheap impl extension, ~10 LOC):
Add small random ±3% pitch jitter PER VOWEL PULSE (deterministic — derived from syllable index hash). Reduces the 'too perfect synth' feel without changing the design.
BOT-vs-PLAYER BIAS — verify shipped:
Read voice-synth.ts bot bias implementation. Confirm bots get harsher waveforms (saw / triangle) + higher pitch per voice-synth-design.md §6.4. If shipped tuning collapsed this distinction, restore.
UNIT TESTS — update + add:
PHRASE_PATCHES snapshot test: update reference values to new tuning.
planUtterance produces schedules with new vowel/consonant lengths.
formantGlideAmount knob: same seed → same glide value (deterministic).
Pitch jitter: same (seed, syllable index) → same jitter offset (deterministic).
Total utterance lengths within updated bounds (~390-670ms).

Listener test in code: assert that a flat-monotone bomber (lowest vowelDrift, lowest formantGlide, lowest jitter) produces a SHORTER spectrum signature than a high-variation bomber on the same slot. Indirectly verifies 'expressiveness' axis works.
PLAYTEST QA BAR — same as voice-synth-design.md §8, RE-RUN POST-TUNING:
Two bombers with seeds 1 + 42 in same round. Blindfolded listener identifies who placed the bomb based on voice ≥ 70% accuracy across 10 events.
Same bomber's pickup vs death vs victory are distinguishable by EMOTION ALONE.
Listener describes the audio as 'they're talking' or 'speaking', NOT 'beeping' or 'chirping'. THIS IS THE FAILING BAR per user feedback.
After this story, the bar must pass.
TUNING ITERATION POLICY:

Acceptable to ship a first cut with reasonable numbers, then iterate via a follow-up tuning story if listener test still fails. Better to ship something audibly improved than to chase perfection in one sprint.
If formant-glide proves too expensive perf-wise: defer impl extension to a separate sprint and ship just the timing tuning. Tuning alone (changes 1-4) should already move the needle.
OUT OF SCOPE:
Replacing the synth backend entirely (e.g. switching to additive partials per voice-synth-research.md §2 row 2 fallback). Tuning + glide should suffice.
Adding 'mouth shape' / 'phoneme transition' modeling (Klatt-style cascade). Heavy.
Per-slot consonant choice tuning (which consonants appear in 'bi-da-bo' vs other slots). Stays as the current selection logic.
Phrase-length variation per bomber (mentioned in voice-synth-design.md §9 future hook). Tuning first; phrase variation later if needed.
